intro: Dear colleagues, here are the geotechnical stories from around the world that caught our eye last week. We gather them from news sources in 20 languages, and the ISSMGE Magazine Presidential Committee (MPC) checks every issue before it is published.

highlights.text: How was a bored tunnel built beneath the Panama Canal waterway, and what ground-control and settlement measures made it possible?
What geotechnical failure mechanisms and tailings dam design lessons emerge from the Mariana collapse, years after compensation was agreed?
How is permafrost thaw and gas migration causing ground collapse and craters across Yamal, and what monitoring and foundation strategies can manage thousands of hazardous sites?
Why did reinforced ground perform far better than untreated sites in repeated shaking, and which improvement methods should be standard practice?

highlights.text: How reliable are machine-learning landslide susceptibility maps when urbanisation, road building and vegetation loss continuously change slope conditions in a city?
